topic: Gojo was sealed by Geto's face and the Prison Realm's rules, not by power
title: Gojo Wasn't Beaten By Power, Just One Familiar Face
description: Gojo is the strongest sorcerer alive, so how did the Prison Realm take him in Shibuya? The answer is in its rules and in whose body Kenjaku wore. Do you call that a mistake or grief?
comment: Was Gojo careless in Shibuya, or was the trap simply unbeatable? Pick one.

lines.text: Gojo wasn't beaten by power. He was beaten by a face.

shot.fallback: white haired sorcerer staring at a familiar face

lines.text: Shibuya, Halloween night, and Gojo walks into a trap built for exactly one man.

shot.fallback: white haired sorcerer in a dark city street

lines.text: Thousands of civilians are trapped inside the barrier, so he can't cut loose.

shot.fallback: crowded city under a black dome

lines.text: Then Kenjaku walks out wearing Geto's body.
The sealing cube has rules. Gojo has to stay within four meters of it for one full minute.
One minute, against the man nobody can even keep up with.

shot.fallback: blue energy swirling around a sorcerer

lines.text: So Kenjaku doesn't try to out-fight him. He gives him a reason to stand still.
Gojo sees his best friend's face, and he freezes. The clock does the rest.

shot.fallback: two young sorcerers in school uniforms

lines.text: People call that carelessness. I think it's the one thing Infinity could never block, grief.
It's the same lesson as Toji. Gojo falls when someone walks around his strength, not through it.
Neither of them beat the strongest. They both found the one door he leaves open.

shot.fallback: sorcerer trapped inside a glowing cube

lines.text: Because Gojo wasn't beaten by power...

shot.fallback: white haired sorcerer staring at a familiar face
